parameter_refs.name: requested_activity
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: destination stop, stand, park, necessary or directed halt

parameter_refs.name: requested_exception
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none, traffic conflict, police or device direction

quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within twenty feet of any marked crosswalk.

activation.condition: A person stops, stands or parks a vehicle near a marked crosswalk.

exceptions.effect: The stated exception may apply after source review
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Assess the source-supported exception without automatic legal classification
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
exceptions.trigger: Necessary avoidance of traffic conflict in compliance with law or applicable officer/device directions

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original purpose, service and motion history require independent activity classification.
Original traffic trajectories and necessity require source review.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic

judgment_calls_needed.note: Applicable law and actual direction authority require source review.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park a vehicle within twenty feet of any marked crosswalk unless an exact exception applies.

timing.description: Observe original approach, stationary/service interval and crossing context.
